meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 当你要求把某个DAG（流程）存下来以后再用时，Claude会将定义保存成文件；之后你说出名字，它就能用一两行代码重新运行该DAG，并自动加时间戳确保每次都是新运行。
howto.when: 当你要求保存一个DAG以便复用、运行已保存的DAG，或需要反复调度同一张图（如每晚/每周审计、周期性多智能体流程）时；触发词如“save this dag”“run the saved dag”等。

say.text: 把这个DAG存成 nightly-audit，以后我可以反复运行
say.note: 会保存为文件，之后可按名字复用。

say.text: 运行我之前保存的 nightly-audit
say.note: 自动加时间戳，每次都是新运行。

say.text: 保存的DAG文件应该放在哪里？
say.note: 会告诉你查找顺序和默认目录。

howto.what_en: Store a named DAG definition as a JSON file; re-run it later by name in one or two lines. Each run auto-adds a timestamp key so old runs are never reused.
howto.when_en: Use when saving a DAG for reuse, running a saved DAG, or re-scheduling the same graph (nightly/weekly audits, recurring pipelines). Triggers: 'save this dag', 'run the saved dag', 'recurring dag'.

say_en.text: Save this DAG as nightly-audit so I can re-run it later.
say_en.note: Stores the definition; reusable by name.

say_en.text: Run my previously saved nightly-audit DAG.
say_en.note: Adds a timestamp key so each run is fresh.

say_en.text: Where should I put a saved DAG definition file?
say_en.note: Explains search order and default dirs.
